card.name: First digit of a number
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly 0, 1 or 2, that begins or sits inside a multi-digit number. It appears in times, verse references, sample sizes and statistics.

modes.label: Verse and time numbers
modes.description: Leading digit after a colon in Bible verses or clock times.

modes.label: Statistics and counts
modes.description: Digit starting a number in trial data, hazard ratios or thresholds.

card.plain: It marks a digit that starts or continues a number, as in verse numbers, times and trial statistics.
